extractions.value: Headache is a very unusual presenting feature of SPS. The patient's headaches were severe, occipital, and attributed to sustained contraction of hypertrophied neck muscles. One headache occurred during sexual activity. The patient had hyperprolactinaemia, sleep apnoea, and bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome. Improvement in headache followed intrathecal baclofen pump placement and occipital nerve blocks.
extractions.quote: We describe a man in whom headache was the presenting feature of an otherwise typical case of SPS. ... It seems likely that the mechanism of headache in this patient was sustained contraction of hypertrophied neck muscles.
